text: Some hand ciphers restart the key at every word, so word boundaries leave a mark. Here the known letters are split into words in all five sensible ways and the key starts again at each.
Letters at the same place in their words take the same key letter. With the sculpture's table the first letters of EAST, NORTH and EAST need 1, 1 and 2: already a clash.
No key of 1 to 26 letters fits any split in any of the 8 tables, on K4 or on any of ten scrambled coppers: the cribs alone rule the idea out.
